description: This file defines a Java interface named ModuleConfigurationService for managing integration modules within the sales manager system, extending a generic service interface.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationService
classes.description: An interface for managing configuration of integration modules in the sales manager system, extending generic entity service for IntegrationModule entities.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of integration modules filtered by the specified module type or name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an integration module based on its unique module code.
